description:
Kimi Raikkonen, Fernando Alonso and Lewis Hamilton enter the 2007 Brazilian Grand Prix locked in a three-way battle for the drivers' championship - which would be decided by one point.

For more F1® videos and all the action, anytime, anywhere, visit http://www.Formula1.com
